jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.location: CA - San Francisco; NY - New York City; WA - Seattle
jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The Role

SoFi is looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead one of our most strategic product areas. As a senior individual contributor and product leader, you'll set vision, define strategy, and drive execution on complex, high-impact initiatives that shape how our members borrow, save, spend, invest, and protect their money.

This role is inherently cross-functional. You will work closely with engineering, design, data science, marketing, operations, finance, risk, legal, compliance, and executive leadership to set strategy, prioritize features, secure resources, and execute. You'll bridge technical and business worlds to drive profitable business growth while managing risk, and you'll influence broader company strategy well beyond the boundaries of your immediate team.

As a product leader in our organization, you'll be expected to inspire with your vision and roadmap, set ambitious goals, be gritty, and be accountable to results. The specific team and product area will be scoped during the hiring process based on business needs and your background.

What you’ll do

-
Own and evolve the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for your product area.

-
Break vision into phases, prioritize, and drive backlogs for launch with your dedicated engineering teams.

-
Drive platform and product strategy focused on scalability, reliability, security, and regulatory compliance.

-
Partner deeply with engineering to make critical architectural decisions and guide long-term investments.

-
Engage with risk, compliance, legal, and security teams to align product capabilities with regulatory requirements.

-
Define success metrics and rigorously measure performance, member impact, and business outcomes.

-
Lead complex build-vs-buy evaluations, including vendor assessments and technology trade-offs.

-
Lead experiments to validate hypotheses and measure impact on key outcomes like member outcomes, engagement, and revenue.

-
Influence broader company strategy, mentor other product managers, and raise the bar for product craft across the organization.

-
Communicate the vision, strategy, execution plan, and customer impact to all stakeholders, including the highest levels of leadership in the company.

What you’ll need

-
Bachelor's degree or higher, ideally in a technical, finance, or quantitative field.

-
8+ years of product management experience.

-
Proven track record leading technically complex or highly strategic products at scale.

-
Deep technical fluency and ability to collaborate with engineers, data scientists, and architects on trade-offs and design decisions.

-
Demonstrated ability to balance long-term platform and product investments with near-term delivery needs.

-
Strong cross-functional leadership skills, particularly with engineering, design, data science, security, compliance, legal, and analytics.

-
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity for diverse stakeholders and present to C-level leadership.

-
Experience owning end-to-end product delivery and P&L or key business outcomes.

-
Comfort navigating ambiguity, trade-offs, and evolving constraints in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to have

-
MBA or advanced degree in a technical, business, or quantitative field.

-
Experience in fintech, financial services, payments, or other highly regulated industries.

-
Experience with data-driven, personalized, or AI-powered consumer products.

-
Experience building and mentoring high-performing product teams.

-
Passion for helping members achieve financial independence and get their money right.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, Checking & Savings
jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The role

We're seeking an analytical, execution-oriented Product Marketing Manager to drive engagement and retention marketing for SoFi Checking and Savings, the foundation of our deposits business and our largest driver of member growth. This role focuses on our existing member base: deepening the relationships we already have, growing and retaining balances and direct deposits, and bringing dormant accounts back to life.

Your core KPIs will be deposits and direct deposits, with a specific focus on growing and retaining balances across our existing member base. You'll own the promotions and offers that ladder to those goals, working directly with the technical teams that build and implement them. You'll work alongside our Lifecycle Marketing team on engagement and retention campaigns, and partner closely with product and engineering on product-led experiments that turn accounts into everyday banking habits. This includes driving ongoing account utilization as well as reducing churn and reactivating dormant members.

Analytical rigor is central to this role. Segmentation, audience development, and offer testing are primary levers for driving deposit and direct deposit growth, and we're looking for someone with the quantitative depth to identify opportunities within the member base and the judgment to prioritize the ones worth pursuing.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a meaningful piece of the business to drive. You'll be the day-to-day marketing owner of this segment of our business, working in close partnership with the Product Marketing lead for Checking & Savings. You'll collaborate with product, engineering, data science, lifecycle, channel owners, our in-house creative studio, finance, and compliance.

What you’ll do:

- Drive day-to-day engagement and retention marketing for Checking & Savings, with core KPIs on deposits and direct deposits across our existing member base

- Grow and retain balances and direct deposit relationships by identifying the highest-leverage member segments, sizing the opportunity, and building the plan to move them

- Own the promotions, sweepstakes, and offers tied to your KPIs, from offer construction and setup through launch, compliance review, and post-campaign analysis, working directly with the technical teams that build and implement them

- Develop sophisticated segmentation and testing programs, designing audience and offer tests that identify and unlock incremental value across the member base

- Partner closely with Lifecycle Marketing to design, launch, and optimize engagement and retention campaigns across email, push, in-app, and other owned channels

- Work with product and engineering on product-led experiments: in-product prompts, feature surfacing, and flows that drive direct deposit and balance growth among established members

- Reduce churn and reactivate dormant members through member segmentation, targeted offers, and disciplined testing

- Build the measurement plan and own the readout: define success up front, read results with an eye toward incrementality, and turn findings into concrete recommendations for the next cycle

What you’ll need:

- 4+ years of product marketing, growth marketing, lifecycle marketing, or closely related experience, preferably in fintech, banking, or another regulated consumer category

- Analytical Thinking: Strong quantitative skills and comfort in spreadsheets and Business Intelligence tools. You can build a segmentation, run a cohort or retention analysis, size an opportunity, read a test result, and clearly explain what happened and why

- Strategic Thinking: Ability to connect day-to-day execution to business outcomes, prioritize where it matters, and make a reasoned case for a recommendation

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven experience working closely with cross-functional teams, especially Product and technical/engineering partners. You can translate marketing needs into requirements a technical team can build against

- Experimentation: Experience designing and running tests in campaigns, in product, or both and distilling results into insights others can act on

- Project Management: Ability to manage multiple concurrent campaigns, dependencies, and deadlines without losing the details

- Communication: Write clearly and concisely; can brief a creative team and present a readout to partners with equal ease

- Initiative & Bias for Action: Eagerness to roll up your sleeves to get things done (even the unglamorous things)

- Bachelor's degree required

Nice to have:

- Experience marketing banking or deposit products, particularly around direct deposit or balance growth

- Experience with segmentation and audience targeting against a large customer base

- Experience building and running promotions, sweepstakes, or offer and bonus mechanics

- Working familiarity with SQL and Business Intelligence tools such as Tableau

- Experience operating in a regulated environment alongside legal and compliance partners

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Borrow and Operations
jobs.location: NC - Charlotte; FL - Jacksonville; TX - Frisco
jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager / Lead to own the product charter for Borrow & Operations technology, with a strong focus on our Home Lending business.

A product manager charter defines the product's vision, scope, and business goals. This role uses that charter to lead cross-functional teams in discovering, building, and delivering a solution that operators and members rely on and that drives sustainable business value.

This is a Senior Manager role (M4). It owns one of IT Operations' most complex companywide programs: the application ecosystem that runs Home Lending from origination through underwriting, closing, and servicing. The leader sets direction, prioritizes the roadmap, and is accountable for reliability, control, and operational outcomes across Encompass 360, Blend, NICE inContact, SoFi-developed applications, and the vendor platforms connected to them.

The role leads a growing team of individual contributors who independently administer, configure, integrate, and automate the Home Lending application portfolio. They set the product vision, sequence the work, clear cross-functional blockers, and hold the team to outcomes: less manual work, faster fulfillment, stronger controls, and a platform that scales with Borrow volume.

The ideal candidate combines product judgment with enough technical fluency to partner credibly with application administrators, engineering, risk, compliance, and Home Lending operations. They are comfortable making decisions where the right product shape is not yet defined, and they know when a choice has long-range implications that need leadership alignment.

What You'll Do

- Own the product charter for Borrow & Operations technology: vision, scope, success measures, and the business goals the roadmap exists to hit.

- Set and sequence the Home Lending application roadmap across origination, underwriting, document management, eSignature and eVault, bureau and third-party integrations, payments, servicing, regulatory data feeds, and employee lifecycle support.

- Lead a new team focused on the Borrow and Home Lending lines of business. Plan their work, coach them, and make resourcing and priority calls so day-to-day administration, projects, and platform improvements stay in balance.

- Lead cross-functional discovery with Home Lending Operations, Engineering, Product, Risk, Compliance, Security, Identity and Access Management, and vendors. Turn operational friction into scoped problems and delivered solutions.

- Decide what to build, configure, automate, or stop. Assess alternatives, operational risk, regulatory impact, and cost, and shape how IT supports Borrow operations.

- Influence function-level decisions by partnering with senior individual contributors and IT and business leadership. Consult leadership when a choice has long-range implications for the platform, the control environment, or the operating model.

- Hold the team accountable for reliability, security, and auditability of Encompass 360, Blend, NICE inContact, SoFi-developed applications, and related integrations, including SOX and regulatory requests.

- Sponsor automation that removes repeatable manual work in provisioning, configuration, data movement, and fulfillment, and measure whether it reduces cycle time and operational risk.

- Own intake and prioritization so investor, partner, servicer, and new-product onboarding is planned rather than absorbed as unscoped administration.

- Represent the product in operating reviews. Surface risks that could cause significant delays, cost, or resource constraints, and drive mitigation with the stakeholders who can act.

- Establish standards for how the team documents configuration, change, and runbooks so knowledge is not trapped with individuals.

- Develop the two Applications Administrators through clear expectations, feedback, and growth toward independent ownership of complex workflows.

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

- Demonstrated experience owning a complex, multi-system product or operations platform in lending, mortgage technology, or another regulated operating environment.

- Experience leading individual contributors, including planning work, coaching, and making priority and resourcing decisions.

- Experience defining a product vision and roadmap and delivering it with engineering, operations, risk, and compliance partners.

- Working knowledge of the mortgage or consumer lending lifecycle and the applications that support it, including origination, disclosures, underwriting, closing, and servicing.

- Enough technical fluency to direct work on configuration, integrations, identity, automation, and change control, and to review the judgment of the administrators who execute it.

- Experience making trade-offs among speed, reliability, control, and cost where a wrong call can affect members, operations, or the control environment.

- Ability to influence peers and senior stakeholders across functions, and to recognize when a decision has long-range implications that need leadership alignment.

- Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain product choices, risk, and operational impact to technical and non-technical leaders.

- A record of improving a live operating platform: fewer manual steps, clearer ownership, stronger controls, and measurable business results.

Nice to Have

- Direct experience with Encompass, Blend, or a comparable loan origination system, as a product owner or as the leader of the team that administers it.

- Experience with Optimal Blue, NICE inContact, eVault or eSignature, bureau integrations, or servicing platforms.

- Experience leading SOX, privacy, or regulatory control work for business-critical applications.

- Experience in FinTech, banking, or mortgage operations.

- Familiarity with ServiceNow or a similar system of record for change, incidents, and request fulfillment.
